display.purpose: The one justified focal financial value on a surface. Used at most once per page.

body.purpose: Row title or primary row value.

shadows.name: surface
shadows.purpose: Resting lift (light tier) for owning cards, grouped surfaces, and panel sections. The white rim is invisible on a pure #ffffff card, where the drop shadow alone does the lifting.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Resting lift (light tier) for capsule and circular controls: buttons, badges, search bars, standalone inputs, header icon buttons, avatar.

shadows.name: primary
shadows.purpose: Resting lift (dark tier) for ink-primary commit buttons and the active segmented-tab/nav pill. Rim dimmed to 12% so it reads as a highlight, not a glare line.

shadows.name: inverse
shadows.purpose: Resting lift (dark tier) for the dark focal financial surface.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Menus, floating navigation chrome, sticky action bars, and tooltips.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The FAB's resting elevation. Reserved for what genuinely floats — never a static dark card, which takes inverse.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets rising off the page.

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: Scale taps and micro-interactions (buttons, icon buttons).

motion.name: spring-smooth
motion.purpose: Slide-up drawers, sheets, modals, meaningful local layout changes.

motion.name: spring-bouncy
motion.purpose: Sliding active-tab/nav pill indicators, celebratory feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one obvious commit action on a surface or sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #181817; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12), 0 1px 1px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.1), 0 3px 8px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.14); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #b84b2c 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A visible supporting action beside a primary commit.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #181817; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #3c3c43 6%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.65), 0 1px 1px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.03), 0 3px 8px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #3c3c43 6%, transparent), 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #b84b2c 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Critical Button
components.description: Solid irreversible-action commit, used only after explicit confirmation.

components.name: Standalone Input
components.description: A white full-capsule field used outside a grouped form panel.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #8e8e93 35%, transparent); background: #ffffff; padding: 0 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.65), 0 1px 1px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.03), 0 3px 8px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.05); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #b84b2c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #b84b2c 35%, transparent); } .ds-input input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #181817; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, #636366 55%, transparent); }

components.name: Grouped Card
components.description: A white owning surface holding related rows with hairline dividers, carrying the resting lift.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #3c3c43 2%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.65), 0 1px 1px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.03), 0 3px 8px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.05); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: #181817; } .ds-card-row:not(:last-child) { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.055); } .ds-card-row strong { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A 24px capsule communicating semantic state with a dot for pending/warning/critical.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.65), 0 1px 1px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.03), 0 3px 8px rgb(24 24 23 / 0.05); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge-healthy { background: #efeff2; color: #181817; } .ds-badge-warning { background: #f6e8e3; color: #b84b2c; } .ds-badge-critical { background: #f4e3dd; color: #97371f; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: An inset-gray capsule track with a sliding ink-primary active pill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: #efeff2; padding: 4px; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; min-height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; color: #636366; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab-active { background: #181817; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Duotone Icon Tile
components.description: A 40px neutral or tinted tile used for repeated-row identity, categories, and priorities.
components.css: .ds-icon-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 16px; background: #efeff2; color: #181817; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Atria looks like a calm surface hiding real operational power underneath. Every screen — Owner dashboard, expense tracker, stock movement, reconciliation — carries genuine financial and material control (budgets, margin risk, cash ledger, over-budget approvals), but presents it the way modern iOS presents a bank balance: flat tonal layering, one confident dark surface for the number that matters, quiet grouped rows for everything else, and a single restrained terracotta accent reserved for what actually needs attention. Nothing shouts. A project team member checking material readiness one-handed at a job site, and an Owner scanning margin risk in 30 seconds from a phone, should both feel the same unhurried confidence — competence expressed through restraint, not decoration.

This is deliberately not a generic SaaS admin dashboard and not a dense accounting spreadsheet. It borrows iOS's clear grouping, confident typography, and disciplined motion, not its glass, gradients, or oversized chrome. The system draws its entire color vocabulary from a monochrome ink-and-canvas foundation plus exactly one accent family (terracotta), so status and priority read through intensity and position, never through a rainbow of category colors.
keyCharacteristics: Solid tonal layering (canvas → white owner surface → inset gray) doing the structural work, finished with a barely-perceptible resting lift on owning surfaces — never glass or heavy elevation
One monochrome ink primary, one terracotta accent family covering both focus and warning/critical
Compact but never cramped: hierarchy carries density, not shrunken type
Fully capsule-shaped controls (buttons, tabs, badges, inputs) contrasted with 28/20/16px-radius container surfaces
Motion is restrained and purposeful — spring-based, never decorative or continuous

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only hue in the system. Warning and critical are the same family at different intensity, not different colors. Healthy, completed, pending, and inactive states stay neutral ink/gray with icon and copy carrying the meaning.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces never take on cream, beige, brown, red, or yellow undertones. A neutral is always drawn from the cool ink/gray/canvas family, never approximated with a warm gray utility.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every monetary value uses tabular numerals so digits never shift width as they change. Primary values stay on one line at 320–430px; fall back to a compact value plus exact secondary value when too long, never a wrapped primary.

rules.name: The One Role Rule
rules.body: Pick the semantic type role whose purpose matches, not the one whose pixel size happens to look close.

rules.name: The Nested-Stays-Flat Rule
rules.body: A surface that sits inside another owner, or that is deliberately recessed, carries no lift: inset metric cells, icon tiles, metric pills, grouped form rows, and segmented-tab tracks. Elevation marks what owns hierarchy, so applying it to a nested element destroys the signal.

rules.name: The Lift-Is-Not-Loud Rule
rules.body: The resting lift must stay imperceptible element-by-element. If a shadow is legible on its own, it belongs to floating chrome (raised/floating/sheet/overlay), not to a resting surface — and if a static card reaches for shadow-floating, the role is wrong, not the value.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent hue (terracotta) system-wide; express urgency through its intensity, never a new hue.

Do give every owning surface and standalone control its semantic resting lift (shadow-surface/shadow-control, or the dark-tier shadow-primary/shadow-inverse), and keep everything nested inside one flat.
Do keep every standalone interactive control a full capsule, and every container surface on the fixed 28/20/16px radius scale.
Do keep primary monetary values on one line with tabular numerals at 320–430px.
Do combine status with copy and an icon/shape/position — never color alone.
Do keep motion purposeful and spring-based (lib/utils/motion.ts presets only).
Do put simple repeated events, transactions, and master-data rows on one grouped surface with dividers; reserve an individual card for a genuinely independent, decision-heavy entity.
Do keep every main route's loading.tsx a structural skeleton matching the final hierarchy, never a centered spinner.
Do keep effective touch targets at 48×48px even when a visible control is drawn smaller, and preserve keyboard focus, screen-reader labels, safe-area clearance, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add a second or third accent color, a rainbow of category colors, or a locally-defined focus-ring color.

Don't hand-roll a shadow value or reach past the semantic role — no shadow-[...], no raw box-shadow, and no shadow-floating on a static card. Never put a lift on a nested row, icon tile, metric cell, or recessed tab track, and never apply blur or glass to an ordinary surface.
Don't use glassmorphism, decorative gradients, or oversized touch chrome anywhere except a configured bank-account identity surface.
Don't wrap a primary money value, or let a value's digits reflow without tabular numerals.
Don't add whole-page transitions, section entrances, or list-stagger animation.
Don't warm a neutral surface with cream, beige, brown, red, or yellow undertones.
Don't ship a generic admin-dashboard or spreadsheet-like composition of summary card, header pill, and identical rounded cards for every section.
Don't use an inset metric grid for a single title/meta/value row, activity/history/transactions, or more than three equal-weight cells in one mobile row.
Don't nest a capsule inside another owning surface for ordinary grouped rows, or place a colored severity rail or short marker beside an ordinary list icon.
Don't leave a hidden action or ambiguous icon-only control without an accessible label, or build UI from placeholder/dummy data when real domain data exists.
